agent_assumptions: Plan coordinate convention: x=0 West, x=15 East, y=0 South (min Y), y=8 North (max Y) -- confirmed by matching elevation window/door spacing to plan dimension chains: North_view.png bottom band (3 windows, 1240/2400/2660/2400/2660/2400/1240) matches the plan's top-of-image office row (now F1_N1/N2/N3 at y=[5,8]); South_view.png bottom band (entry door at 3440mm offset + 3 windows) matches the plan's bottom-of-image lounge row (now F1_S1/S2/S3 at y=[0,3], with entry door D_F1_S1_ext at y=0). The seed had these two rows swapped in Y (and consequently mislabeled window facades N/S) relative to this evidence; corrected via a y-axis reflect.

Uniform wall abstraction: exterior/partition wall thickness not individually modeled; rooms defined on a centerline grid (bays at x=0/5/7.5/10/11.25/15, y=0/3/5/8) derived from the dimension strings, reconciling to the 15.0 x 8.0 m envelope.
Floor-to-floor heights (F1=3.0 m, F2=3.6 m, total 6.6 m) taken directly from all four elevation drawings; F2 elevations use absolute world Z (z_floor=3.0).
Window sill/height per elevation dimension chains: F1 South/North row windows sill 1.0/h1.6m; East/West and all F2 windows sill1.0/h1.8m.
Interior door heights standardized to 2.1 m (not dimensioned on plan); F1 South entrance and West corridor exterior doors set to 2.4 m based on elevation glazing proportions.
Room F1_S1 small secondary window (South facade near entrance) has no explicit dimension string; size/position (0.7m wide, sill1.8m) is an inferred placeholder.

Redundant paired door leaves at shared partitions (F1 N/S rows, F2 M1/M2, and F2 O1/O2 & O3/O4) are each modeled as two separate corridor-facing doors (one per room), matching the two-arc pattern visible at every such partition in the drawings, rather than as a single direct room-to-room opening.

No door was modeled between F2 offices O2 and O3: zoomed inspection of that partition shows a plain continuous wall with no arc marks, unlike the O1/O2 and O3/O4 partitions which each show two corridor-facing arcs.

unresolved: No staircase/vertical circulation is drawn on either floor plan; F1-F2 connectivity is not represented as a modeled opening (would require fabricating an unevidenced stair location).
Exact wall thicknesses vary (240mm exterior, 340mm corridor partitions, 360mm office partitions); a single representative centerline grid was used instead of literal face-to-face offsets.
Door swing/open-closed state is not indicated on the drawings; all doors marked state=unknown.
Minor (<0.3 m) discrepancies exist between two independent plan dimension chains for the corridor width (1500mm vs 1200mm implied); 2.0 m corridor clear span adopted as reconciling value.

Exact widths of the newly reclassified O1 and O4 corridor doors (near the O1/O2 and O3/O4 partitions) are estimated at 0.8m by symmetry with neighboring doors; not independently dimensioned in the available crops.
